question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever done a school program where you took care of a fake baby?
Which section did you like best?

nodes.text: Sam pats the baby's back and rubs her belly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Quiet down now, $ERIKBABY... You don't want to cry, do you?
The baby starts quieting down.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good work. You'll be a great mom.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know about that... But I seem to do okay...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No problem.
Ryan climbs out of his car, baby in hand, and tries to make a run for it, but Colt's motorcycle bars his way.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not so fast, Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Not so stupid, `stupid!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not so stupid, [color=#e23b3b][i]stupid![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That doesn't even make sense!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Just get out of my way!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not without $COLTBABY!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Why are you even stealing babies anyway?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Because some red-headed thief stole mine, okay?! I need it!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: And don't even try to threaten me! If you take one step, this baby's getting it.
Ryan starts to twist the baby's arm backwards.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anything you do to hurt that baby, I'm going to do to you!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: `Gulp.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gulp.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, uh... You'll have to catch me first!
Ryan throws the baby as high as he can and starts running off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa!
Colt lunges for $COLTBABY and catches her. When he stands up again, Ryan is gone.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When I see that guy tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's gonna get a beating.
Colt looks down at the baby in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But for now... I'm just happy to have you.

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Back to this again, huh? Let's just go home...
Back at Denni's house...

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you crying about? I saved your life...
The baby continues to wail despite Colt's frantic patting.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, you're fine!
Colt looks at the baby. On her elbow is a burn mark from the fire earlier.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, kind of.
Colt takes a closer inspection. There are a lot of scratches on the baby's arms and legs.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's probably from the car chase...
Colt turns her over where he finds a red sticky spot on her dress that smells suspiciously like a popsicle.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I don't even want to know how you got that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmm... What am I going to do? ...I don't have any bandages...
Colt roots around for a first aid kit, but finds none. He checks his pockets and pulls out a small sheet of stickers.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maddie's always giving me these gifts...
Colt looks from the stickers to the baby.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yes...
A little while later...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Honey, I'm home!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've always wanted to say that. But it just seems so old-fashioned.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How's our little $COLTBABY?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We had a pretty eventful day, but I think it went okay.
Colt hands Denni the baby.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... Why is our baby covered in stickers?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't think of them as stickers... Think of them as... Bandages!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why does $COLTBABY have `bandages` all over her?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why does $COLTBABY have [color=#3b78e2][i]bandages[/i][/color] all over her?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, 'bandages' is bad. Think of them like tattoos!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Arguably worse!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay... So the baby had kind of a rough day...
Colt looks at Denni's face.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh-oh. I know that face... I'm in trouble, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Let me start by saying that it's not my fault...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Stop it, Colt!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I left you with one job. To take care of $COLTBABY! And then I come home to this!
Denni points to the sticker-laden baby.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks to you, I don't even think we'll `pass` this assignment!
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks to you, I don't even think we'll [color=#3b78e2][i]pass[/i][/color] this assignment!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You are going to go home right now, and I am going to stay here and take care of this baby by myself!
Denni shoves him out the front door.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait, this wasn't all my fault, I swear! There's a reason the baby looks all scratched up, and it's not because of me! You don't know the whole story!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `Save it for Ms. Lee.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Save it for Ms. Lee.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Denni shoves him outside and shuts the door behind him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw man...
The next day...
Colt and Denni walk up to Ms. Lee, holding their battered baby up. Ms. Lee inspects the baby disdainfully.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, it looks like you two had an interesting night...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It seems like `some of us` just aren't responsible enough to get it together!
nodes.text_bbcode: It seems like [color=#3b78e2][i]some of us[/i][/color] just aren't responsible enough to get it together!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ms. Lee, I know this looks bad, but hear me out...
And so Colt explains everything to Ms. Lee. About his troubles with Ryan...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ryan stole $COLTBABY right out of my hands! I hopped on my motorcycle and started chasing him...
Only stretching the truth a little bit...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah, it was totally Ryan's fault that he burned the baby when his car shot off sparks after I rammed it with my bike!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And after I cornered Ryan, I threatened him, but he gave the baby back. And that's why the baby looks like... This.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: See? I'm not a bad parent... Just an awesome one!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's okay, Colt. You had me at 'motorcycle chase.' How exciting that you'd chase a criminal down for your baby! It's just so vigilante!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Kind of like my last boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Anyway, you and Denni are better parents than I thought you would be!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What did you think before?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Never mind. You passed!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Okay, next!
Ms. Lee turns back to the line of students waiting to turn their babies in.
Colt and Denni walk back to their seats.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sorry for not listening to your explanation. I can't believe Ryan put you through all that!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's cool. He's a jerk!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know... I'm kind of proud of you, Colt. Thanks for stepping it up. I honestly didn't think we'd pass.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I really 'Colted' my way out of that one!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know... I think that's catching on...
Good job! You helped Colt out of some very tough situations!
Colt may have made some mistakes, but he made up for them in heart, just like any good parent!
Now, let's check in on Howard and $ZOE...
Colt climbs off his bike and approaches Ryan's car warily.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Ryan?! You in there?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Yeah! I mean, no!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I heard that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come out of the car, and no one has to get beat up! All I want is the baby!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Never!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't make me go in there and slap you...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'd like to see you try...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You've got the tickets for the front row seats, man.
Colt walks closer to the car...
And all of a sudden, the car's engine revs!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Hey! Turn that off!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Not my fault you're too stupid to catch me!
Ryan quickly backs the car out of the dead-end street and turns out onto the street!
Before Colt can do anything, Ryan is out of sight.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: He's... He's gone!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When I see that creep, I'm going to smash in his face!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Denni is `not` going to like this...
nodes.text_bbcode: Denni is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] going to like this...

nodes.text: Later that afternoon...
Denni comes home.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, honey, I'm home!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I've always wanted to say that. But it just seems so old-fashioned.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How's $COLTBABY?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, Denni... You look really good today.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No seriously, you look so awesome... It's the awesomest awesome you've ever been.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Why are you acting strange?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: ...Wait, where is our baby?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You'll never believe what happened...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Won't I?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I kind of... Lost her...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You `lost` our baby?! How could you do this, Colt?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]lost[/i][/color] our baby?! How could you do this, Colt?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I thought I could trust you!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And now, I don't know if I can ever forgive you!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If it makes you feel better... I've already forgiven myself.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Arg!
She flies at him, and Colt can see this is going nowhere good.
Uh-oh! If only Colt had done a slightly better job at taking care of $COLTBABY!
You'd better try again and see if you can put things right!
But first... Let's check in Howard and $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No way are you getting away with that!
Colt glances around and sees his motorcycle parked in front of the house.
He hops on and...
Colt's motorcycle comes to life, the engine roaring.
He accelerates onto the road, closing the gap between him and Ryan!
Colt instinctively brakes!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aw, why the heck am I braking?!
Colt shakes it off and starts his bike. The motorcycle thrums to life!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Finally!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Finally![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He takes off after Ryan, closing the wide gap between them!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, scumbag!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's my baby! Bring her back!
Hearing the shout and the motorcycle engine, Ryan changes course and makes a beeline for a car on the side of the road!
He jumps inside, starts the car, and starts speeding down the road!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `A car's not going to stop me! I've taken down a helicopter!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]A car's not going to stop me! I've taken down a helicopter![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt takes off after him.
They race down the busy suburban street...
Colt weaves around cars and pedestrians as he tries to catch up to Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm too slow dodging all the traffic! I need a straightaway!
A couple more miles, and at last, there's a long stretch of road!
Colt accelerates, closing the distance!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just a little further...
A truck turning onto the road suddenly comes in between them!
Colt brakes to avoid it and realizes Ryan is getting away!
Colt fumbles with the accelerator and fails to speed up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Crap!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Crap![/i][/color]

nodes.text: When he finally gets a grip, his chance is gone!
Colt tries to zip through traffic as fast as he can, but he realizes Ryan is getting away!
Colt looks around and sees a small alley where he can ride through.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think there's a shortcut through there... If I take it... I can get in front of Ryan and cut him off!
Colt turns down the narrow street.
He flies in and out of the small, back ways of the neighborhood until he finally pops out onto the main street again.
Colt comes out right in front of Ryan!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Got you now!
He zooms across Ryan's path and forces him to make a right turn into a dead-end street blocked by a wall!
He comes out right behind Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No!
Colt accelerates, keeping close to Ryan's car...
Until Ryan makes a right turn onto a dead end street, blocked off by a wall!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Lucky break for me...
Colt jumps to his feet.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Hey you! Stop right there!
For a second, Colt freezes in place, unable to move.
He stares dumbly at Ryan as he gets farther and farther away.
Then he shakes it off and struggles to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Cough. Cough.
Colt looks around at the smoky kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But maybe it's better if we head outside...
In the front yard, Colt spreads out a blanket and sits with the baby in his lap.
He holds the bottle up to $COLTBABY's mouth.
The baby registers the bottle and quiets down at last.

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Coo! Coo! Coo!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Finally. Geez. Taking care of this thing's a pain.
Colt lays down, the baby in his arm.
The baby turns into the crook of his elbow, and Colt smiles.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, maybe you're not so bad. When you're not being loud and screechy.
They stay that way a while longer...
Colt can feel himself drift off to sleep...
And that's when the baby is snatched from his arms!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sucker!
He sees Ryan race down the street, $COLTBABY in tow!
In one smooth move, he tosses the flowers, grabs the vase, and douses the baby's sweater with the water inside!
The sweater sizzles, and a burst of smoke escapes... But the fire is out.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Crisis. Averted.
Colt takes a kitchen towel and starts swatting at the fire.
It flares higher!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nope! Not working!
Colt looks around the kitchen and spots the sink!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Beat fire with water!
Colt runs over to the sink, baby in hand. He grabs the spigot and turns the water on!
Cold water sprays on both him and the baby, but at last the fire subsides.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... Danger. Over.
Colt runs frantically from one end of the kitchen to the other.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do I do?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `What. Do. I Do?!`
Colt stops and slaps himself.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Pull it together, Warren!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great. So it's almost time for class. I'll take care of $COLTBABY until the end of the day.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You don't think I can handle her?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Do you want to take care of her first?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not really. I just... Wanted to look... More awesome.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Aren't you sweet?
Denni kisses him.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can take it from here though. And then maybe you can come over after school and watch the baby with me?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sure...
The bell rings, and Denni places $COLTBABY in her accompanying stroller.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Meet you after school!
After school, Colt finds Denni waiting impatiently at the school entrance.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Colt... Bad news... I can't babysit. I have to go to my doctor's appointment...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Isn't that tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, the doctor said he had something come up, so he wants to check my leg brace today.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Can you take $COLTBABY while I'm gone?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh, sure...
Denni pushes the baby into Colt's arms, and it immediately starts crying.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Whenever she starts crying, just pat her back.
Colt awkwardly pats the baby, and it stops.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: See? You're a natural. I'm already feeling better about leaving her with you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've taken care of plenty of babies.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How many?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just one. But that's baby enough! Don't underestimate me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You do know my name is related to 'baby horses', right?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So maybe, 'Colt' means to 'raise an adorable baby'!
At that moment, Ryan runs past.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'm gonna Colt the crap out of my history test!
Denni looks at Colt, her eyebrow raised.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...It hasn't caught on yet.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Look, Colt, all I'm asking is that you take care of our baby for an hour. At the most.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You can even just watch her at my house, and I'll join you later.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Anything I should know?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, you'll probably have to feed her. The last time she 'ate' was at lunch. And then maybe you could take her for a walk in her stroller.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: After that... The worst you'll have to deal with is changing her diaper.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That's pretty gross...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Luckily, it's a fake baby, so... It's just water.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Still gross.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Any questions?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You kidding me? I got this.
Denni gives Colt a kiss on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks! I swear, I'll be back as soon as I can.
Denni limps towards a waiting car. As she leaves, Colt looks back at the baby.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, $COLTBABY, it's just you and me. Maybe we can get along.
At Denni's house...
Colt is watching TV when the baby starts crying!

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!
Colt tries patting her on the back, but nothing happens.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh... Don't cry... Baby thing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Are you hungry? I bet you're hungry.
Colt picks up $COLTBABY and heads to the kitchen. He starts warming a pot of water on the stove to put into a bottle.

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah! Wah!
Colt bounces the baby up and down.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sh! Don't cry... You're happy, you really are!

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, come on... How long does it take for water to get hot?!

nodes.speaker: Dolt
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!
At last the water is warm. Colt sets the baby down on the counter next to the stove and grabs the pan.
Carefully, he fills the bottle and tests it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Perfect. Who's the best daddy? That's me!
When he turns around again...
The baby's sleeve has caught on fire!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh no, no, no!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Crap crap crap!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What... What do I do?!
Colt looks around the room. On the counter, he spots a huge vase of flowers and a dish towel...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Face it, Denni...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You and I have completely different ideas of what a good name is. We're never going to agree on something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can't we just accept her as Colt Junior, short for Coltina or something?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I do kind of like Coltina...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: There we go.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Coltina Junior Arthur Warren it is!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Arthur? Don't you think...
Colt holds up a hand.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! Don't question the genius.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Not questioning...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I guess we can try to come up with something together.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How about famous women?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Good thinking! We could do famous feminists like Eleanor Roosevelt or Elizabeth Cady Stanton or Susan B. Anthony...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Too... Smart...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Someday, you'll have to accept that being 'smart' is a good thing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was thinking more about famous women `wrestlers...` Lynette the Hornette? Miss Cantankerous Bikini? Cypress Tigress?
nodes.text_bbcode: I was thinking more about famous women [color=#e23b3b][i]wrestlers...[/i][/color] Lynette the Hornette? Miss Cantankerous Bikini? Cypress Tigress?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Those are... Weird. And mildly disturbing.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You got anymore?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How about women in history? Marie Antoinette... Anne Boleyn...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Aren't they dead?
And five minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I've got it! We can combine our names together. Our baby's name can be 'Kenni' or...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: 'Dolt'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, I like it ironically...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds like the only name we can compromise on...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great, then our child's name is 'Dolt'.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great.
Rewinding back to the time Ms. Lee first assigned the project...
Ms. Lee activates a robot baby and hands it to Colt and Denni.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Congrats! You have a beautiful baby girl. Take care of her now!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Teach her to distrust men and break a glass ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you mean `the` glass ceiling?
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you mean [color=#3b78e2][i]the[/i][/color] glass ceiling?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't know that there's a specific one...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh, sure thing, Ms. Lee.
Denni takes the baby and holds it up for Colt.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a girl.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what's wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing! It's just... I always figured I'd have a boy. Besides, I have a younger sister, and I know what girls are like.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They're all neat, well-behaved, and freaky.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Lighten up, she has your eyes.
The robotic baby burps.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And apparently your manners.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just kidding! What do you think we should name her?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Colt Jr.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: She's a `girl.`
nodes.text_bbcode: She's a [color=#3b78e2][i]girl.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What's your point?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... I was thinking of a more feminine name like... Sadie or Piper...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa... We are not naming her after girls with huge glasses and skinny jeans.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Fine, what about Denni Jr.?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: 'Denni Jr.'? Really? Come on...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's wrong with that?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Er... She's not even half as awesome as you?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I'll accept that answer...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But that still doesn't solve our naming issue. Why don't we find a name we can both compromise on?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well...
They spend the afternoon peacefully together until at last it's almost time to sleep...
Erik and Sam sit on the couch together. Erik holds their baby and a book.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You want to read a good night story to her?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They say reading to your child is important to their verbal and lingual development!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. You know what? Why not?
Sam plops down on the sofa with their baby and opens the book.
She reads from the first page...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Mucky the Ducky was a lucky ducky indeed...'
Sam continues to read to $ERIKBABY until she finishes the book.
Then Sam and Erik lay $ERIKBABY down to sleep in the basket Erik bought for her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good night, little one.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Night, kid.
They leave the baby in Sam's bedroom. Sam walks Erik to the door.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for taking her tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: See you in the morning!
Erik starts to walk off, but then stops, remembering something.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, you know... If she starts crying...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know what to do.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, you do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Erik... I know I gave you kind of a hard time today...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... The truth is, I didn't really want to work on the baby project with you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But it's because I haven't been having the best of luck with guys lately.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, Spencer, and Nick... They've all let me down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I didn't want to be around guys, even for an assignment. But you showed me that not all guys are unreliable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Thanks for being such a good partner. And a good friend.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Captain Quark always says it takes `two` compatible laser guns to take out a Tartonian cannon... What I mean is, you were really good too!
nodes.text_bbcode: Captain Quark always says it takes [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] compatible laser guns to take out a Tartonian cannon... What I mean is, you were really good too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha, thanks for the vote of confidence. Good night, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good night, Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not... Oh, never mind. Samantha it is.
The next day at lunch...
Sam is sitting with the swim team when she sees Erik again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Ericson!
Erik comes over.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Got a second? I've got the worst pain in my back from sleeping weirdly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about a back rub?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sam... I like you and all... But that was all for the project.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now that we've returned the baby...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Say no more. I get it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I hope your back feels better!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Great! See you around!
Sam sits back down with the swim team girls.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: What was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Do you actually `like` him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you actually [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] him?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... He was just... Really nice...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it was nice to work with someone like that... Even for just a little while...
Good work with Sam and Erik! You managed to show Sam that a father as over-doting as Erik is great to have around... Especially when you have a baby to take care of!
Now let's see how Colt and Denni are doing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't do this, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What you want me to do is sweet... It really is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But $ERIKBABY's not alive. See?
Sam knocks on the hard plastic of the baby's head.
$ERIKBABY begins to cry.

nodes.speaker: Jordan
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey! You just knocked right on her soft spot!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Her what?
Sam turns the baby over.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't hurt her!
Erik snatches the baby away from Sam and brings her close.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Shh... $ERIKBABY. You're okay now. I've taken you away from the mean lady...
The baby immediately stops crying.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The `mean` lady?!
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]mean[/i][/color] lady?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who goes around knocking on kids' heads?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I didn't realize that you were that kind of person...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What kind of person?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A bully!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But she's plastic! She isn't even real!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you keep saying that, she'll eventually believe it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't let $ERIKBABY stay in these conditions!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good day, ma'am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I said, `good day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said, [color=#e23b3b][i]good day![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik grabs the diaper bag and dashes out of Sam's house with the baby, running into the night...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... That could've gone better...
We totally agree! Erik Ericson stormed out of Sam's house in a huff?
Might be a good idea to try again and see if you can be a little bit more supportive as a parent!
In the mean time... Let's see how Colt and Denni are doing...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's not going to college.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's a horrible thing to say!
Erik clasps his hands around the baby's ears and lowers his voice.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't you think she's smart enough?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm `sure` she's smart enough...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]sure[/i][/color] she's smart enough...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you do know that none of this is real, right? $ERIKBABY isn't actually a girl.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah... I know that. But you have to practice for this kind of thing, Samantha...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's Sam.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Practice makes perfect.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, fine. I suppose you're right.
Erik turns back to his newspaper in stony silence.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't limit her options just yet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There are a lot of public universities that she can go to. They cost less, don't they?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're exactly right!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm sure you'll figure out a way to get her to go to college.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks for your support, Sam!
Erik turns back to his perusal of the newspaper while Sam finishes up her homework.
Sam continues to freak out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do I do? `What do I do?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What do I do? [color=#3b78e2][i]What do I do?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You yelling is probably stressing her out more!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `I'm` the one who's stressed out! Take her! Please!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one who's stressed out! Take her! Please!

nodes.text: Erik takes the baby from Sam and begins comforting her.
In a moment, the baby stops crying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: See? It's okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do you really think she can `hear` you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you really think she can [color=#3b78e2][i]hear[/i][/color] you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was talking to you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah, it is okay... Thanks for taking care of her...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... How do you want to do this? You take the baby for the day, and I'll pick it up tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can't just leave me alone with her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Believe me, it's probably better that you take care of it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You can think of me as more... 'Hands-off'...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think it's important that we work together... For $ERIKBABY.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I can take the baby for the rest of the day, if that would make you feel better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: See you later, Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's `Sam!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color]

nodes.text: After school...
Sam is talking with the swim team when she notices Erik pushing a stroller.
He scans the lot, and his eyes brighten when he sees Sam.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Samantha! Over here!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Looks like Nerd-boy is calling for you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ERIKBABY misses you!
Sam sighs and waves Erik over.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ha ha, you were paired up with Erik for the biology assignment?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wow, you and Nick have been broken up for less than a week... And you already have a baby with another guy... `That` was fast!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, you and Nick have been broken up for less than a week... And you already have a baby with another guy... [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was fast!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha, very funny. It's just an assignment, Hannah. Besides, I could care less... Erik's doing all the work.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Not bad. At least he doesn't subscribe to outdated models of conventional female-male spheres.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You two must be so happy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut up. I have to go.
Sam says goodbye to the swim team and meets Erik. Erik parks the stroller and drops a bright bag on the floor.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whew! That's a workout!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is the baby's bag! It has everything we need. Diapers, bottles, a spare change of clothing in case of accidents...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And a baby book called 'Mucky the Ducky'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where'd you get all this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ms. Lee. She was real helpful!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That woman scares me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, are you ready to trade off?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Trade off? We're not going to spend time with our baby together?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... I'm not really into 'together' right now. I'm done with guys... So it might be better for both of us if I do it alone.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But $ERIKBABY...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Will be fine.
Sam takes the baby... And it starts to cry...

nodes.speaker: Jordan
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, geez! What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Reassure her. She likes to be patted on her back... Or you could rub her belly...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well... It lacks a certain... Specificity...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't want to get too attached.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That does make sense...

nodes.speaker: Jordan
nodes.text: Coo! Coo! Coo!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And $ERIKBABY seems to like it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: At least it's very factual...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like it!

nodes.speaker: Jordan
nodes.text: Coo! Coo! Coo!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And $ERIKBABY does too!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You chose it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I did, didn't I? But... You didn't seem to like it very much. What changed your mind?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eh. It was as good a name as any.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Besides, you seem to care more about this than I do.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like it!

nodes.speaker: Jordan
nodes.text: Coo! Coo! Coo!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And $ERIKBABY does too!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So do I.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It sounds like she could be a sports star or a news anchor!
Picking up from when everyone was choosing their partners...
Sam walks up to Ms. Lee to talk to her privately.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Yes, dear?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Do we `have` to partner up with somebody? I'd rather just, you know, go it alone.
nodes.text_bbcode: Do we [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to partner up with somebody? I'd rather just, you know, go it alone.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Sam, this is a `group` activity! You could do it alone, but trust me, I think you'll want a partner before tomorrow.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sam, this is a [color=#3b78e2][i]group[/i][/color] activity! You could do it alone, but trust me, I think you'll want a partner before tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Single motherhood is a long and hard road, peppered with expensive bills, lonely nights, and emotional eating.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are... Are you a single mother, Ms. Lee?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Just what are you implying?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's perfectly fine for a woman to be single in her forties. `Single` is the new `married...`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's perfectly fine for a woman to be single in her forties. [color=#3b78e2][i]Single[/i][/color] is the new [color=#3b78e2][i]married...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I just meant...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind. So about my partner...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Your partner, yes! Why don't you go with Erik? I'm sure he doesn't have a partner yet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really want to work `alone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I really want to work [color=#3b78e2][i]alone...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, he does wear thick glasses...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't see how that relates...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And he does lack that certain bad boy appeal that a girl like you would want.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wait... Are you trying to match us up... `Romantically?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... Are you trying to match us up... [color=#3b78e2][i]Romantically?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: If it's because of his weird personality, I would say... Don't underestimate the quiet ones. They probably won't leave you.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Mr. Ericson! Over here! I've found you a partner!
Erik skips down the aisle to sit down next to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Howdy ho, Samantha! Ms. Lee said we were going to be working together!
He sticks out his hand. Sam shakes it hesitantly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, first of all... The name's Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Second of all... Don't be so sure we're partners...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure we are...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And why's that?
Erik points to the board Ms. Lee is writing the groups on.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Because our names are on the board! You know what happens when a name goes up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?
Erik whispers to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It never comes down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, we're fixing this. Right now.
Sam drags Erik up to the front where Ms. Lee is handing out dolls.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ms. Lee... There's been a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No. I don't think so...  Because you've just had a baby girl!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No way...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whee!
Ms. Lee shoves the robot baby into Sam's arms. She feels immediately like dropping it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, this is the worst...
Erik whisks it away from her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What a beautiful baby!
Erik starts singing to the baby.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { I'm going to take care of you all the time... And quiet you down... {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: { And be with you all day... As I carry you around town... {

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hmmm... Maybe having Erik around to take the baby away isn't such a bad idea after all...
Erik stops rocking the baby and looks to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So do you still want a different partner?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No. It's fine. It's only for a day, right? You can do anything for a day.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll just partner up and get this project over with.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay! First things first!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What should we name her?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know... Baby?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, she is a girl. We could give her a more girly name. I've always liked Esther!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Blech.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, `you` can choose the name.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] can choose the name.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't care?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's our baby! Of course, I care!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But she's not just mine. She's also half yours. So you choose.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'll stick by whatever name you want! That's called sacrifice! I do it all the time because of all the warm feelings it brings!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... What about something more boyish... Like Jordan?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Really, it's all fine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I choose...

nodes.prompt: What do you name the baby?

menu.text: What do you name the baby?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, my situation's worse!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think it is! You just think your practice is more important than mine!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not saying that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just explaining why `I` can't be the one responsible for the baby!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just explaining why [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] can't be the one responsible for the baby!

nodes.text: Between them the baby starts to cry...

nodes.speaker: Howardbaby
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!
Howard and $ZOE stare down at it for a moment...
And stop fighting.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's just put this aside for now...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The baby needs us.
$ZOE picks up the baby and tries to comfort it, but to no avail.
Howard pats the baby's back, but nothing changes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I have one last trick...
Howard presses a toy rattle into the baby's hand, and it stops crying.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How'd you learn that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I used to take care of Kay and Kel. They weren't easy. I'd always have to figure out ways to make them quiet down when they were like this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whenever they cried, I'd give them shiny objects until they stopped.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm starting to see how they learned about bribery...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Start 'em young.
They look at one another, and $ZOE gives Howard a kiss.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: About who takes the baby... How about we compromise? We'll each go to half of our practices.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You stay with the baby while I go to my practice, talk to the girls, and dismiss them early.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then, I'll take the baby, and you go play football for the second half of your practice.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, okay... It's better than fighting about it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah really...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, so our first fight about the baby...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can we not ever do that again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, I think we did pretty well...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll make great parents someday...
$ZOE takes Howard's hand and thinks about their future together...
How their life might go...
What choices they'd each have to make to stay together after Howard graduates...
She smiles uncertainly, but looks up into Howard's eyes when she says...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Someday.
Great work getting Howard and $ZOE to work together!
It's hard being a parent when you have such a busy schedule, but thankfully Howard has $ZOE to help him figure everything out!
Now they seem happier than ever!
...And continue arguing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We'll deal with the baby later. Right now, we need to decide on `this.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We'll deal with the baby later. Right now, we need to decide on [color=#e23b3b][i]this.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't agree more!

nodes.speaker: Howardbaby
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I'm Head Cheerleader. I `have` to be at practice, and I `can't` have any more distractions.
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard, I'm Head Cheerleader. I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be at practice, and I [color=#3b78e2][i]can't[/i][/color] have any more distractions.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, football is off-season right now!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not even practicing for anything!

nodes.speaker: Howardbaby
nodes.text: Wah! Wah! Wah!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like what? All of the games you're going to play in fall? You're graduating next year.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: None of these practices matter!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If I'm leaving, it's all the more reason I `should` go!
nodes.text_bbcode: If I'm leaving, it's all the more reason I [color=#e23b3b][i]should[/i][/color] go!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'd rather spend my last days here treasuring my moments with the football guys!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Instead of with you!
Howard turns away from her and sprints towards the football field.
$ZOE yells after him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See if I care what you do!
$ZOE heads towards the park where cheerleading practice is being held.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The nerve of him! I can't believe he'd be so `insensitive!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The nerve of him! I can't believe he'd be so [color=#3b78e2][i]insensitive![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe Ms. Lee was right! Maybe we should never have partnered up for the baby project!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The `baby!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The [color=#3b78e2][i]baby![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE sprints back to the section of the parking lot she's left her baby in...
...But he's gone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $HOWARDBABY? $HOWARDBABY?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `$HOWARDBABY!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]$HOWARDBABY!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: So... Let me get this straight... You got into a fight and left the baby in the parking lot?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But only for just a second! I don't know what would have happened to him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is this going to impact our grades?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Negligent parents certainly don't get 'A's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Did you at least learn a little something from this project?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. It taught me how selfish `some people` can be.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. It taught me how selfish [color=#e23b3b][i]some people[/i][/color] can be.

nodes.text: Howard glares at $ZOE. She glares right back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I learned just how `thick-headed` the jocks are at this school.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I learned just how [color=#3b78e2][i]thick-headed[/i][/color] the jocks are at this school.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Excellent, excellent. How lovely that we can learn all these lessons together...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I love it when school imparts on youth the basic lessons of life.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: See you two later!
Oh no! Howard and $ZOE are so angry at each other that they're not speaking?
What a disaster of a school project! Try again and see if you can get them to get along next time!
And that's it for our couples!
We hope you enjoyed this special episode of Surviving High School!
To all fathers everywhere... We wish you a `Happy Father's Day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: To all fathers everywhere... We wish you a [b]Happy Father's Day![/b]

nodes.text: Howard bristles at $ZOE's tone.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just told you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way Coach is going to let me bring a kid onto the field!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So naturally, it'd have to be you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't like that you think I `have` to be the one to take him!
nodes.text_bbcode: I just don't like that you think I [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to be the one to take him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'd get in just as much trouble with the cheerleaders as you would with your coach!
Before $ZOE blows off steam, she takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I can't stop in the middle of practice to take care of a baby. The girls wouldn't be very happy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: They'd probably react better than Coach.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm also the new Head Cheerleader. I dictate what everyone does.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Doesn't that mean you can make the rules now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, but I'm not going to do that. Jessica made rules up all the time to benefit herself. That's not what a leader is, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's why I don't want to take the baby to my practice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...And why are we assuming that `I'm` going to be the one who has to handle it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Because I might get in trouble with Coach.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might get in trouble with the girls!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you see why I'm so upset?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really agree with it, but I see your point.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good. So no more feeding $HOWARDBABY bottles that touched the floor?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You still don't think it's good for him? I heard it's not good to shield your baby from `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You still don't think it's good for him? I heard it's not good to shield your baby from [color=#e23b3b][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, fine...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a good thing $HOWARDBABY is just plastic, or I'd really be in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I `know` you're upset...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you're upset...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it just doesn't seem like this whole big problem you're making it out to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not a problem? Howard, don't you care at all? This is our baby!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I `do` care... But I think we just have to `agree` that we're always going to `disagree` on this.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] care... But I think we just have to [color=#e23b3b][i]agree[/i][/color] that we're always going to [color=#e23b3b][i]disagree[/i][/color] on this.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: At least $HOWARDBABY is just plastic, or I'd really be in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just important to me that we get this assignment right.
At that moment, the bell rings for class. Howard puts the baby in the stroller.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So I'll take the baby for seventh period... Does that work?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. We can switch in between. I'll pick her up for the last period of the day.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And then we meet after school?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep!
Later that day...
$ZOE meets Howard in the parking lot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Howard...
Howard whisks $HOWARDBABY out of his stroller and tosses him in the air.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How's the future quarterback of the football team doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just fine. He cried a little, but then he went back to sleep...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or whatever it is dolls do when they just lay there...
Howard puts $HOWARDBABY back in the stroller.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you think you'll be okay taking care of $HOWARDBABY when I'm at practice?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you're at practice?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, Coach called us in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't take $HOWARDBABY. I have cheerleading practice to go to.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So which one of us should take him?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can't skip practice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you can't slack off in football. If I don't show, my coach will not only yell at me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He'll make sure everyone else gets punished.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And trust me, you do not want to be the guy that is responsible for making the entire team run 10 miles.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what should we do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe we can find a babysitter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Someone has to be willing to do it...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah! That's a good idea! There's a ton of people also working on the baby project...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll call my friends. You call yours?
A few minutes later... $ZOE and Howard check back in with one another.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Brendan's at the mall. He wouldn't be able to pick up $HOWARDBABY in time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I tried Hector, but all I got was a frantic explanation about having to stop Amanda from breaking the law...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam's at home. She couldn't get here in time either. And everyone else I know is on the cheerleading squad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So we're back at square one...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And practice is starting soon...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I hate to say it... But you have to take $HOWARDBABY...
Anger wells up in $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `I` have to?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] have to?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What does that have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They have better immune systems. They can handle stuff like germs. Babies can't.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh... I never thought about it that way before...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So they're a little hyperactive, but that doesn't mean they're freaks, or anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I didn't mean to insult them, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's different with babies.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They're uh... Weird!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kay and Kel eat things off the floor all the time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's a big difference between our baby and your sisters.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Our baby is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... It's stupid!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It is not!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's not. Do you know how many lost pretzels I've recovered because of that rule?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And let's not forget about all the precious cookie crumbs that get left behind... What would happen to them? Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eww...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, $ZOE... It's not that big a deal...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a myth! It doesn't matter how long food is on the ground...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bacteria still gets on it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? Then why is it so popular?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... Guys really hate to waste food?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can see that... But come on, $ZOE... It can't be that big of a deal.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE.
Howard reaches for the baby bottle, but it slips out of his hands and falls to the floor!
It rolls around before coming to a stop at the edge of the table leg.
Howard picks up the bottle as if nothing happened and tests the water on the inside of his wrist.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh well. Good enough.
He sticks the bottle in the baby's mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ew! You can't just do that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Put the bottle in $HOWARDBABY's mouth after it's been on the floor!
$ZOE reaches out for it, but it falls right out of her fingers and bounces on the ground.
The bottle cap pops off, warm water spilling all over the floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the worst...
$ZOE picks up the bottle and grimaces. It's covered in dirt and old, moldy food.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Guess I'll have to wash it off and refill it all over again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: At least it's not really milk.
A few minutes later...
$ZOE walks happily over to Howard with the new bottle.
$ZOE lunges forward and catches it right before it lands on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes!
$ZOE straightens and walks happily over to Howard.
Rewinding back to biology class when everyone was picking up their fake babies...
Howard and $ZOE walk up to Ms. Lee.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're ready for 'parenthood'!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You two are partners?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why do you look so surprised?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I just never thought the two of you would be compatible together!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ms. Lee! We've been together forever!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I don't enjoy being made fun of, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's telling the truth, Ms. Lee...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, well, if you say it, it must be true, Herman.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now normally, I recommend that couples don't do this project together.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Children put strain on relationships. They quickly become a test of how much you want to be with one another.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ms. Lee I'm sure we'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, we're very committed.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: That's exactly what my first husband said.
Ms. Lee stares off into the distance and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Can we get our baby now?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Oh, right!
Ms. Lee turns to the box of dolls.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do we get to pick the gender of the baby?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I don't care! What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A boy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I guess a boy `would` be fun.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I guess a boy [color=#3b78e2][i]would[/i][/color] be fun.

nodes.text: Ms. Lee hands them a baby boy. As soon as the baby is placed in $ZOE's arms, it begins to cry!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Crying already? That's a sign of a troubled home.
Howard and $ZOE walk away with their baby.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sh, baby... Shhh... It's okay...
The baby quiets down. Howard takes it and plays with it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, what should we name him?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I feel like I chose the gender... So you should choose the name. Whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Yay!

nodes.title: Enter a baby name!
nodes.prompt: What do you want your baby's name to be?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I like it. He looks exactly like a '$HOWARDBABY'.
Baby Name Approved!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
She looks down at the doll in her arms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, he's so cute!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah... He's perfect.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is going to be so much fun! We're going to be the best parents ever!
At lunch, Howard and $ZOE walk their baby into the make-shift cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who's the best little boy in the world?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: $HOWARDBABY is!
They bring their baby to a table. Howard changes the baby's diaper.
Afterwards, $ZOE changes the baby's clothes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There we go. All clean and new!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess all that's left is to feed him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got the bottle right here... I'll go fill it up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll put the bib on.
$ZOE walks across to the snack counter to get some warm water for the bottle.
She fills it, screws the top on, and almost gets to the table...
When suddenly Zach runs into her, knocking the bottle free from her hand and sending it flying!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whoa, hey, sorry!
But $ZOE doesn't hear him! She only has eyes on the bottle that's arcing through the air...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Having Erik around to deal with this is definitely a perk...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So... Do you want to take her tonight, and I'll pick her up tomorrow morning?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... You're right. Let's just stick it out. Together.
At Sam's house...
Sam is finishing up her homework when she realizes that she hasn't heard from Erik or $ERIKBABY in a while...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik?
There's a noise from the kitchen, and the sound of Erik's shout.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yow!
Sam ducks her head into the kitchen.
Erik is squirting the contents of a bottle onto the inside of his wrist.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Testing the milk!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that real milk?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yep! Nothing but the best for my little one. But it was a little too hot... I might have burned myself...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wonder if anyone else thinks it's `really` creepy that you have to feed a fake baby...
nodes.text_bbcode: I wonder if anyone else thinks it's [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] creepy that you have to feed a fake baby...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute... Was that the last of `my` milk in `my` fridge?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, wait a minute... Was that the last of [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] milk in [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] fridge?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had big plans to use that for my afternoon bowl of cereal!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But it's going to a good cause...
Erik takes the baby and feeds her the now-warm milk.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You... I can't... Ugh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Use your words.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't `need` to take care of the baby this much. It hasn't even cried yet.
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] to take care of the baby this much. It hasn't even cried yet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, `she` hasn't. That's because I've been doing such a good job with her.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, [color=#e23b3b][i]she[/i][/color] hasn't. That's because I've been doing such a good job with her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: After this, I'm going to change her diaper and then lay her down for a nap.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay... Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You just focus on what you have to do.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Your education is important to the happiness of this baby.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Seriously! Get good grades! The higher yours are, the higher hers will be!
Sam wanders back to the kitchen table to finish up her homework, muttering.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm starting to regret letting him in on this project...
Twenty minutes later...
Erik enters the room and sets down a plate of cookies and a cup of hot tea in front of Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What is this?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Something sweet for someone sweet! I fixed it up when I prepared little $ERIKBABY's snack.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, I know these cookies... They're the Girl Troop ones...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They're my favorite!
Sam looks at Erik and notices he's changed into a sophisticated looking blazer and some fuzzy bunny slippers.
He's brought a newspaper in with him and has opened it up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what are you wearing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is that my mom's blazer?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik, you can't just come into my house and wear my mom's clothes and use all my stuff to make nice things for me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, it sounds selfish when I say that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But `seriously... `
nodes.text_bbcode: But [color=#3b78e2][i]seriously... [/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik neatly folds up his newspaper and stands.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, you're looking a little tense. All that stress can't be good for you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can give you a back rub!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If you think you can distract me... Wait, did you say 'back rub'?
A few minutes later...
Sam stretches out her arms and neck.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yep... That's the spot. You're really good at this.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My mom was a masseuse... She taught me the ways.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You learned well. Wow, that really put me in a good mood.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Anything else I can do for you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... The back rub was great...
Sam snags a cookie from the plate and sips it down with the hot tea.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And these are tasty!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, why don't you just kick back and relax... I'll check on how the stock market is doing...
Erik sits down and peruses the newspaper.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Interesting... Did you know that the SHS stock is soaring through the roof? Now's the time to buy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But unfortunately, housing in the area around the best schools just keeps going up and up...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not to mention private college tuition these days... Whew! They're getting expensive.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a good thing I've got such a stable job at the office... The market's so dicey right now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And why are you looking at college tuition?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: For $ERIKBABY of course! These are important things we need to think about.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's nuts if he thinks this baby thing is actually real... I wonder if I need to tell him it's all pretend...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Erik, I hate to tell you this, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `just` washed that, and now, it has `germs` on it! Again!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] washed that, and now, it has [color=#3b78e2][i]germs[/i][/color] on it! Again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was on the floor for like two seconds... Ever heard of the five second rule?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, the five second rule is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I kept the bottle off the floor, specifically so it `wouldn't` be dirty.
nodes.text_bbcode: I kept the bottle off the floor, specifically so it [color=#3b78e2][i]wouldn't[/i][/color] be dirty.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now, it has `germs` on it...
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, it has [color=#3b78e2][i]germs[/i][/color] on it...

nodes.text: It was on the floor for like two seconds... Ever heard of the five second rule?

nodes.text: Howard, the five second rule is...

Hector comes up to Amanda carrying two ice cream cones.

nodes.text: In honor of Father's Day, we bring you an episode that is entirely about what it's like to be a parent!
It's biology class, and Ms. Lee is standing at the front of the room.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Good afternoon, class...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I know you're used to seeing Mr. Russell's gorgeous face up here... But he's had to take a few days off to go on a `tropical, romantic vacation!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you're used to seeing Mr. Russell's gorgeous face up here... But he's had to take a few days off to go on a [color=#3b78e2][i]tropical, romantic vacation![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Apparently, there's just no talking him out of `proposing` to his `long-time girlfriend.` Disappointing.
nodes.text_bbcode: Apparently, there's just no talking him out of [color=#3b78e2][i]proposing[/i][/color] to his [color=#3b78e2][i]long-time girlfriend.[/i][/color] Disappointing.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But don't worry! We'll have a lot of fun without him! Today, I'm in charge.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh-oh.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, really...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe it won't be so bad.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And we're going to talk about `babies!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And we're going to talk about [color=#3b78e2][i]babies![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I take back what I said.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The school board has mandated that every student undergoes a program called 'Baby Think About It'.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All of you will have the opportunity to take care of a baby to appreciate the difficulties of parenthood.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: A real baby?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No, Ryan... Sadly, the school board won't allow students `or` single, financially secure guidance counselors access to real babies...
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Ryan... Sadly, the school board won't allow students [color=#3b78e2][i]or[/i][/color] single, financially secure guidance counselors access to real babies...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But that's another matter!
Ms. Lee gestures to a line of life-like baby dolls on the counter behind her.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You will each pair up into 'couples' and be responsible for one of these robotic babies.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Your grade depends on the 'happiness' of your baby when you return to me at the start of class tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You will need to comfort them when they cry, feed them warm water through a bottle when they're hungry, and change them at different intervals.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And before any of you try, mistreatment of your child will be recorded by your baby! Any couple who treats their baby badly will be `flunked.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And before any of you try, mistreatment of your child will be recorded by your baby! Any couple who treats their baby badly will be [color=#3b78e2][i]flunked.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Flunked?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: No, I'm just kidding!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... Heh.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: But you will get an F on the assignment!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Now, everyone, couple up, and then I'll start handing them out!
Around the room, all the students start pairing up.
In the back of the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey babe, you want to be the mother of my baby?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's really creepy, you know that, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I accept!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This baby stuff should be `easy.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This baby stuff should be [color=#e23b3b][i]easy.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We haven't even started the assignment... Don't get too cocky...
In the very front of the room...
Erik approaches Ashley shyly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Ashley, do you want to partner up?

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Sorry, Erik... Dex already asked me. We're going to program our baby to walk!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, okay...
Erik moves down the line of tables, looking for a partner and finds Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor, would you...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Taken. Too bad, so sad, have a boyfriend.
In another corner...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hecky-Wecky, do you think we can get every doll in the collection?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We don't want to catch them `all,` Manda-Panda...
nodes.text_bbcode: We don't want to catch them [color=#e23b3b][i]all,[/i][/color] Manda-Panda...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's not really the point.
And last but not least...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... Want to be in a couple?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! This is going to be super fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Easy for you to say... I don't want to partner up with `anyone...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Easy for you to say... I don't want to partner up with [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Now let's take a look at the different couples and see how they fare!
